subtitle.zh-CN: 建立发球节奏与抛球稳定性
subtitle.en-US: Build Serving Rhythm and Toss Consistency

overview.zh-CN: 从站位、抛球到完整挥拍链路，帮助初学者建立可重复的发球动作。
overview.en-US: From stance and toss to full swing sequence, this course helps beginners build a repeatable service motion.

keyPoints.zh-CN: 抛球高度与击球点统一
keyPoints.en-US: Align toss height with contact point

keyPoints.zh-CN: 重心前送与肩髋协同
keyPoints.en-US: Coordinate forward transfer with shoulder-hip rotation

keyPoints.zh-CN: 发球后落地与回位
keyPoints.en-US: Landing control and quick recovery after serve

subtitle.zh-CN: 建立稳定抛球与完整发力链
subtitle.en-US: Build Toss Consistency and Full Serve Chain

overview.zh-CN: 聚焦标准发球动作，从准备、抛球到击球收拍，建立稳定且可重复的发球节奏。
overview.en-US: Focus on the standard serve sequence from setup and toss to contact and follow-through, building a repeatable serving rhythm.

keyPoints.zh-CN: 抛球点位稳定在身体前上方
keyPoints.en-US: Keep toss placement stable in front-above contact zone

keyPoints.zh-CN: 下肢蹬转与躯干传导协同
keyPoints.en-US: Coordinate leg drive with trunk force transfer

keyPoints.zh-CN: 击球后快速回位准备下一拍
keyPoints.en-US: Recover quickly after contact for the next shot

subtitle.zh-CN: 缩短引拍，提高网前处理效率
subtitle.en-US: Compact Preparation for Faster Net Play

overview.zh-CN: 通过网前脚步与拍面控制训练，让正手截击更稳、更快。
overview.en-US: Train footwork and racket-face control to make your forehand volley more stable and efficient.

keyPoints.zh-CN: 分腿垫步后第一步启动
keyPoints.en-US: Explode after split-step timing

keyPoints.zh-CN: 拍头略高于手腕，减少挥拍幅度
keyPoints.en-US: Keep the racket head slightly above wrist with short action

keyPoints.zh-CN: 击球后迅速回中封网
keyPoints.en-US: Recover quickly to central net coverage

subtitle.zh-CN: 建立反手网前的拍面稳定

overview.zh-CN: 聚焦反手截击击球点与躯干协同，减少失误并提升压迫力。
overview.en-US: Focus on contact timing and torso alignment to reduce errors and increase pressure at the net.

keyPoints.zh-CN: 肩部带动小幅度向前推送
keyPoints.en-US: Drive forward through shoulder-led punch

keyPoints.zh-CN: 重心前压，不后仰
keyPoints.en-US: Keep body weight forward at impact

keyPoints.zh-CN: 反手位封堵直线与斜线
keyPoints.en-US: Cover both line and crosscourt from backhand side

subtitle.zh-CN: 控制低平来球与节奏变化
subtitle.en-US: Control Low Trajectory and Rhythm Change

overview.zh-CN: 学习如何用正手削球降低球速、压低弹跳并打乱对手节奏。
overview.en-US: Learn to reduce pace, keep bounce low, and disrupt opponent rhythm with forehand slice.

keyPoints.zh-CN: 拍面开放角度与下切方向
keyPoints.en-US: Control open face angle and cutting path

keyPoints.zh-CN: 击球点保持在身体前侧
keyPoints.en-US: Contact in front of the body

keyPoints.zh-CN: 结合落点深浅做战术变化
keyPoints.en-US: Vary depth to create tactical pressure

subtitle.zh-CN: 提升反手防守与过渡质量

overview.zh-CN: 通过单手与双手反手削球模型，建立稳健的防守过渡能力。
overview.en-US: Use one-hand and two-hand slice models to build reliable backhand defensive transitions.

keyPoints.zh-CN: 提前侧身，保证下切轨迹
keyPoints.en-US: Turn early to lock in the slicing path

keyPoints.zh-CN: 前臂与手腕保持稳定
keyPoints.en-US: Keep forearm and wrist stable through impact

keyPoints.zh-CN: 削球后快速回到中位
keyPoints.en-US: Recover to neutral position after slice

subtitle.zh-CN: 提升反手稳定性与击球质量
subtitle.en-US: Improve Backhand Consistency and Ball Quality

overview.zh-CN: 围绕反手击球的准备、转体与挥拍节奏，提升来回相持中的稳定落点和持续压迫能力。
overview.en-US: Build backhand stroke rhythm from setup, rotation, and swing timing to improve rally depth and sustained pressure.

keyPoints.zh-CN: 提前转肩，缩短反手准备时间
keyPoints.en-US: Turn shoulders early to shorten backhand preparation

keyPoints.zh-CN: 击球点前置，保证拍面稳定穿透
keyPoints.en-US: Contact in front for stable racket-face penetration

keyPoints.zh-CN: 收拍后迅速回中，保持连续对抗
keyPoints.en-US: Recover quickly after follow-through for continuous rallies

subtitle.zh-CN: 建立单反挥拍结构与稳定触球
subtitle.en-US: Build One-Handed Structure and Stable Contact

overview.zh-CN: 从站位、引拍到击球后收拍，循序建立单手反拍的动作连贯性与落点控制。
overview.en-US: From stance and take-back to contact and follow-through, build one-handed backhand fluency and directional control.

keyPoints.zh-CN: 非持拍手辅助转体与节奏控制
keyPoints.en-US: Use non-racket hand to assist rotation and rhythm

keyPoints.zh-CN: 击球点保持在身体前侧
keyPoints.en-US: Keep contact point in front of the body

keyPoints.zh-CN: 收拍后重心回中，准备下一拍
keyPoints.en-US: Recover center balance quickly after follow-through
